Name: Herbal Wines for Cornucopia and Wildflour's
Author: Yuzu17
Description:
[color=#ff00ff][size=4][font=sans-serif][b]Description[/b][/font][/size][/color]
[font=sans-serif]Turn 35 different herbs—including those categorized as vegetables—into herbal wines, each with its own hand-drawn high-resolution bottle. Requires Sprites in Detail. [/font]
[font=sans-serif]Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23823]Uppergrade (Bigger Keg)[/url].[/font]



[b][color=#b6d7a8][size=4][i]Herbal Wines HD - Supported Herbs[/i][/size][/color][/b]
====================================================

Manifest.Name: Herbal Wines HD
Manifest.Description: herb_itemタグを持つハーブから作ったワインに、専用に描いたボトル外見と専用の基本売値を割り当てるコードMod。既知のハーブ35種は手動で1つずつボトルを割り当て済み、未知のハーブも自動計算でフォールバック表示。品質・Artisan・利益率の補正は通常通りその上に適用されます。実際のHD描画は本物のSpritesInDetail([SID] Herbal Wines HD)が担当します。[CP] Herbal Wines / [CP] Herbal Wines HD Bottles / [SID] Herbal Wines HD と併用してください。
Manifest.Author: Yuzu17

Manifest.Name: Herbal Wines
Manifest.Description: Turns items tagged as herbs into flavored wine. Compatible with EBAGI and Upper-grade.
Manifest.Author: Yuzu17
